env.name: lbf_20x20
env.notes: Partially observable LBF matching TAGET's cooperative setup (ICML 2025): 20x20 grid, 4 food, 2 agents, 5x5 view (fov=2). force_coop + shared reward make it fully cooperative like TAGET (both agents must co-locate to collect; team reward normalized to the food fraction). Added to test whether partial observability restores the offline teammate-modeling discrimination that full-obs lbf_12x12/mpe_spread lack. Episode horizon stays at Jumanji's 100 (TAGET uses 50; time_limit is not a config knob here).
